verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). The docs host a generated API-reference page for the Computer Analytics endpoint (GET /v2/analytics/computer/usage), which suggests Computer's REST surface appears in that spec. Machine-readable discovery is also served via llms.txt and RFC 9728 OAuth metadata for the MCP server. Missing for 10: confirmation that the OpenAPI spec actually covers Computer's endpoints (the probe did not inspect its contents), a machine-readable spec for the core MCP task-delegation surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the spec.
